items.cheapest_check: The plan comparison against the two Not-applicable items (GH-ID-03, GH-ID-04), read against the firm's client commitments.
items.unknown: Whether the firm's exposure justifies moving to GitHub Enterprise Cloud, which SAML single sign-on and IP allow lists require.
items.why: GH-ID-03 and GH-ID-04 are Not applicable on the Team plan (A1, A6), and so are restricted email notifications, the owner-only invite restriction in GH-MEM-03 and token attribution in GH-AUD-02; whether those are worth a plan change is a business decision, not a setting.

items.cheapest_check: Organization settings -> GitHub Apps -> each app's Configure page, then ask the staff who use chat notifications and CI.
items.unknown: Whether the chat notification app and the CI service installation are still used, and who owns the chat app (C4).
items.why: An app nobody owns is uninstalled under GH-TOK-06; until use and ownership are known that item stays Unknown.

items.cheapest_check: Resolve the name and look up who holds the address it points to; then remove the DNS record and delete the webhook.
items.unknown: Who operates the endpoint at ci-old.aldercreek.example now (F3).
items.why: If the name now resolves to someone else's server, organization event payloads have been going to a third party since October 2026, and Chain C's last step is live.

items.cheapest_check: The owner opens Settings -> Password and authentication on their own account and lists the registered methods.
items.unknown: Which two-factor methods are registered on the second owner's account (A5).
items.why: If an SMS method or no passkey is registered, Chain A's second step needs only a relayed code; a registered security key would narrow it to the TOTP fallback.

items.cheapest_check: Theo Marsh checks Settings -> Developer settings -> Personal access tokens (classic) for the deploy token's scopes and last use; the former vendor is asked to revoke its staff member's token.
items.unknown: Whether the two known classic personal access tokens still reach the organization (C3).
items.why: A classic token carries its holder's access without appearing on the organization's token pages: the vendor staff member's token works for as long as F-5 is not done, and the deploy script's token has never been reviewed. GH-TOK-04 stays Unknown until both are settled.
